title: Response Class Share by Employer Benefit Charging Class
content:
The response class share measures how much of the disputed money a separation response under Employer Benefit Charging can carry, according to the employer's charge class and the claim the position charges.

## Rule

The response class share is the whole (1.00) when the position charges a regular or combined wage claim and its charge class allows relief for a voluntary quit, a discharge for misconduct and a refused offer of work; when the class allows continuing part-time relief and none of those separation grounds, it is the most recent charge posted over the counted charges, the one week a continuing-employment answer can contest; and zero (0.00) otherwise, as on an Extended Benefits state-share position, whose relief follows the determination on the regular claim.

## By class

Applied to the grounds each class allows, the rule gives:

| Charge class | Separation or continuing-employment grounds the class allows | Response class share |
|---|---|---|
| Separating Employer — Most Recent | Voluntary quit, discharge for misconduct, refused work | 1.00 |
| Base Period Employer — Proportional Share | Voluntary quit, discharge for misconduct, refused work | 1.00 |
| Combined Wage Claim Contributing Employer | Voluntary quit, discharge for misconduct, refused work | 1.00 |
| Extended Benefits State-Share Employer | Voluntary quit, discharge for misconduct, refused work — but the position charges an Extended Benefits claim | 0.00 |
| Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer | Continuing part-time only | Most recent charge posted over the counted charges |
| Reimbursing Nonprofit Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Continuing part-time only | Most recent charge posted over the counted charges |
| Reimbursing Governmental Employer — Dollar-for-Dollar | Continuing part-time only | Most recent charge posted over the counted charges |

## The continuing part-time fraction

- *The most recent charge posted* is the amount of the benefit charge with the latest posting date on the position.
- *The counted charges* are the charges the response counts. Where the response counts no charge, the fraction does not arise and the share is zero.
- The fraction is used as it stands, without rounding of its own.

**Hypothetical figures.** A Continuing Part-Time Base Period Employer whose response counts $900.00 of charges, the most recent of which is $150.00: the response class share is 150 over 900, one sixth.
